# Knowledge

Memory across threads, reference repositories, search over past threads, prompts and other agents' logs, readable web pages, and fast file search.

Pack id `knowledge`. Back to [all packs](README.md).

## Plugins

1. [`@dshfiles/memory`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/memory/README.md) — Cross-thread memory for DSH: digests idle threads from the session logs, starts each thread with a small frozen memory block, and adds memory_search / memory_read / memory_note.
2. [`@dshfiles/references`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/references/README.md) — Named outside directories or git repositories attached to a session as read-only reference material.
3. [`@dshfiles/session-search`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/session-search/README.md) — Owns the sessionQuery search backend: an off-thread FTS5 index fed incrementally from session logs, so a content search is a pure read that never blocks the Host event loop.
4. [`@dshfiles/prompt-stash`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/prompt-stash/README.md) — Save and reuse shared prompt snippets.
5. [`@dshfiles/fff-search`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/fff-search/README.md) — Agent grep and glob backed by a resident fff file and content index instead of one ripgrep spawn per call.
6. [`@dshfiles/agentsview`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/agentsview/README.md) — Browse, search and read the session logs of other local agent CLIs (Claude Code, Codex) inside DSH, read-only, with token totals per agent and model.
7. [`@dshfiles/web-fetch-readable`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/web-fetch-readable/README.md) — web_fetch provider for ctx.web: follows cross-origin redirects with per-hop public-address revalidation, accepts more text types and extracts the readable article.
8. [`@dshfiles/resource-packs`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/resource-packs/README.md) — Typed property packs attached to referenced resources, shared by the GUI, plugins and agents.

## Prerequisites

1. A project is added.

## Key settings

1. **Keep memory across threads**: Settings entry `dshfiles-memory`, field `enabled`.
2. **Search every prompt you sent**: Settings entry `dshfiles-prompt-stash`, field `promptHistory`.

## Enable it

1. In the app: **Knowledge › Getting started**, then **Enable pack** on Knowledge under Packs. It previews exactly what changes; **Disable pack** reverses it.
2. From an Agent: the `onboarding_pack_apply` tool with pack `knowledge`. It runs only when you ask, after showing the preview.
3. From a shell: `dshx init --profile <name> --packs knowledge` (Core is added; `--dry-run` previews). See [`dshx init`](../../tooling/dshx/docs/cli-reference.md#dshx-init-compose-a-profile-from-packs).

## Restart

Installing a plugin the profile does not have yet needs a DSH Host restart: DSH reads the profile once at boot. Plugins already installed are switched on in the running DSH. Nothing restarts on its own: use **Restart when idle** in the sidebar when DSH runs under the managed launcher, otherwise your own launcher.
